summary: @elpatronhimself Think scholars should submit in their preferred language rather than the default Hegemony of English. At least both, we put the labor of translation and the fear of L2 writing on too many novice scholars. #SpeculativeEd
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @elpatronhimself Think scholars should submit in their preferred language rather than the default Hegemony of English. At least both, we put the labor of translation and the fear of L2 writing on too many novice scholars. #SpeculativeEd
